summary.description: Plan a fictitious weather report from deterministic sample observations. Scheduler simulation receipts illustrate the workflow; they do not create a CSV or chart.
summary.estimate_note: Authored estimates only; excludes review, retries and overhead. Not a forecast.

tasks.title: Specify sample observations
tasks.description: Describe a fixed 30-row sample temperature table and its columns.
acceptance_criteria: Sample columns and row count are specified.

tasks.title: Check sample quality rules
tasks.description: Define missing-value and range checks for the sample table.
acceptance_criteria: Quality rules are documented for later real validation.

tasks.title: Specify daily averages
tasks.description: Define the grouping and arithmetic mean calculation.

tasks.title: Define anomaly flags
tasks.description: Specify which sample temperatures would receive warning flags.
acceptance_criteria: Threshold and warning semantics are specified.

tasks.title: Design trend chart
tasks.description: Specify chart axes, labels, and accessible text alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: Chart design and alternative text are described.

tasks.title: Review weather report plan
tasks.description: Combine the quality, anomaly, and chart specifications into a report outline.
acceptance_criteria: All predecessor specifications are referenced in the outline.
